description_en: Cancels the License authorization for a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口取消指定产品的License授权
kebab_example: aliyun iot unbind-license-product --iot-instance-id iot-s3000 --license-code 480P --product-key gq62z000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnbindLicenseProduct

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Enterprise instance. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh: 企业版实例的实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The License type (audio and video specification). Valid values: **480P** and **720P**.

You can view the License type of the target product on the **License Management > Product Authorization** page in the **Audio and Video Communication Service** console
parameters.help_zh:
License类型（音视频规格），可取值：**480P**、**720P**。

您可在**音视频通信服务**控制台的**License管理>产品授权**页面，查看目标产品的License类型
parameters.name: license_code

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product for which you want to cancel the authorization.

You can view the **Product Key** of the target product on the **License Management > Product Authorization** page in the **Audio and Video Communication Service** console
parameters.help_zh:
待取消授权的产品的ProductKey。

您可在**音视频通信服务**控制台的**License管理>产品授权**页面，查看目标产品的**Product Key**
parameters.name: product_key
